summary: Skyasterix reviews Syonis, a new Legendary Shadow element hero in Dragonheir: Silent Gods. Syonis introduces a unique Energy Drain Zone mechanic via his Ultimate skill, locking himself and the enemy with the highest Attack into a duel where neither unit can gain energy or target other heroes. With his Battle Skill boosting Shadow allies' Attack and Shadow Energy, his Passive lowering enemy Defense in a forward zone, and his Inspired 2 upgrade enabling damage that ignores immortality, Syonis elevates Shadow teams to top-tier status across Arena, Vortex, and dungeons.

meta_changes: Shadow teams become dominant in Arena with Syonis locking down main enemy DPS heroes and bypassing immortality at Inspired 2.
Passive Defense reduction on frontline enemies enables faster boss clears in dungeons and Temporal Vortex.
tips: Prioritize pulling for Syonis if running or building a Shadow team.
Aim for Inspired 2 (I2) on Syonis for high-level PvP to bypass enemy immortality effects.
Place Syonis strategically on the field so his Passive aura covers enemy frontline tanks or threats.
